description: UI layer: rewrite lib/main.dart, create lib/app.dart (GoRouter), all four screens, and the ShiftTile widget. Depends on FEAT-001 being complete (all models and services must exist).
steps: Step 1 — lib/main.dart: Rewrite to async main(): call WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized(), tz.initializeTimeZones() (import package:timezone/data/latest_all.dart as tz), instantiate AlarmService and StorageService, call await alarmService.init(), then runApp(ShiftRemindersApp(alarmService: alarmService, storageService: storageService)).

Step 2 — lib/app.dart: Define GoRouter with routes: '/' -> HomeScreen, '/import' -> ImportScreen, '/rules' -> RulesScreen, '/permissions' -> PermissionsScreen. Add a redirect on '/' that calls storageService.isFirstLaunch() and redirects to '/permissions' if true. Create ShiftRemindersApp StatelessWidget that receives AlarmService and StorageService as constructor params and returns MaterialApp.router. Pass services to screens via GoRouter extra where needed.

Step 3 — lib/widgets/shift_tile.dart: Create ShiftTile StatelessWidget. Constructor: ShiftTile({required Shift shift, required ShiftRule? rule}). Show ListTile with: title = DateFormat('EEE d MMM yyyy').format(shift.date), subtitle = rule?.displayName ?? shift.type.name, trailing = rule != null && shift.type != ShiftType.off ? formatted alarm time : 'No alarm'. Apply greyed-out TextStyle when shift.isPast.

Step 4 — lib/screens/permissions_screen.dart: StatefulWidget. In initState do nothing; show explanatory text and 'Grant Permissions' button. On button tap: request Permission.notification (both platforms) and Permission.scheduleExactAlarm (Android only, guarded by Platform.isAndroid). After request, call storageService.setOnboarded() then context.go('/'). Also show 'Skip' TextButton that just calls setOnboarded + go('/').

Step 5 — lib/screens/home_screen.dart: StatefulWidget. In initState load shifts from storageService and load rules. Build ListView.builder over shifts with ShiftTile. AppBar actions: IconButton(Icons.settings) -> context.go('/rules'), FloatingActionButton or AppBar action with Icons.add -> context.push('/import').then((_) => _reload()). Empty state: centered Column with icon and text 'No shifts imported yet. Tap + to import a CSV.'

Step 6 — lib/screens/import_screen.dart: StatefulWidget with _parsedShifts list. 'Pick CSV File' button calls FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.custom, allowedExtensions: ['csv'], withData: true). On result: decode bytes as utf8, call CsvParser.parseCsv(), setState with parsed shifts. Show preview ListView. 'Confirm & Schedule Alarms' button: load rules from storageService, call alarmService.scheduleAll(), call storageService.saveShifts(), Navigator.pop(), then show SnackBar via the home screen's ScaffoldMessenger (pass count back via pop result or use a global key).

Step 7 — lib/screens/rules_screen.dart: StatefulWidget. Load rules and nightBefore in initState. Show ListTile per non-off shift type with alarm time editable via showTimePicker. Show separate tile for night-before notification time. On each time change: update state and call storageService.saveRules(rules, nightBefore). AppBar back button returns to home.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze reports 'No issues found!' on the entire project
lib/app.dart GoRouter correctly defines all four routes and the first-launch redirect
lib/screens/import_screen.dart: picking a CSV file triggers CSV parsing and shows a preview list
lib/screens/import_screen.dart: confirming import calls alarmService.scheduleAll() and shows a SnackBar with count
lib/screens/rules_screen.dart: each shift type alarm time is editable and persisted
lib/screens/home_screen.dart: displays imported shifts with ShiftTile and navigates to import and rules screens
lib/main.dart: initialises timezone data and AlarmService before runApp
